question: Does the original-selected seven-module response program transfer to OOD text and compose with the exact block-10 residual-identity stream into a stable, selectively decomposable writer interface?

fixed_response_prefix.rule: The prefix was selected on original FIT and validated on original HOLDOUT. OOD FIT and HOLDOUT are both sealed validation; no module, order, boundary, threshold, row, or coefficient may be reselected.

arms.native: Native run capturing block-10 entry and all A10--M17 outputs.
arms.writer: Compact-writer run capturing block-10 entry and all A10--M17 outputs; this is the joint target.
arms.identity_full: Writer block-10 entry with all sixteen complete module outputs clamped native (factorial R1M0).
arms.response_full: Native block-10 entry with all sixteen complete module outputs clamped writer (factorial R0M1).
arms.P7_response: Native block-10 entry plus exact writer outputs for the frozen P7 sites; every other module remains live.
arms.P7_plus_identity: Writer block-10 entry plus exact writer outputs for the frozen P7 sites; every other module remains live.

predictions.pred_a_authority_pairing_capture_full_ar: All immutable parent authorities match; the writer, identity_full, and response_full OOD effects replay v2; all state/module hooks fire once; exact six-forward price and finiteness pass.
predictions.pred_b_original_selected_p7_response_tra: P7_response passes the registered recovery, cosine, residual, and direction bars on both OOD FIT and HOLDOUT.
predictions.pred_c_p7_response_composes_with_identit: P7_plus_identity reaches .9--1.1 recovery, cosine >=.98, relative residual <=.2, and direction >=.9 on both OOD phases.
predictions.pred_d_both_physical_streams_are_needed_: Identity_full and P7_response each lie in [.2,.8] recovery and adding the other stream to reach P7_plus_identity contributes at least .2 signed writer-effect fraction in both phases.
predictions.pred_e_two_stream_composition_is_nearly_: The vector interaction P7_plus_identity - identity_full - P7_response is <=.15 relative to the joint writer effect and every nonnative arm has temporal command-gold collateral <=.01 in both phases.

nulls.invalid: If A fails, no scientific result is interpreted.
nulls.p7_ood_null: If B fails, the original-selected response prefix is not a stable OOD circuit program.
nulls.noncomposable: If B passes but C fails, P7 and identity do not form a stable executable OOD interface.
nulls.redundant_single_stream: If B/C pass but D fails, preserve redundancy/dominance rather than claim a necessary two-stream decomposition.
nulls.nonadditive_or_nonselective: If B--D pass but E fails, preserve interaction/collateral rather than claim a simple selective two-stream program.

prior_art_and_novelty: Repository search found complete-module factorials, a ten-site response lattice, the exact full-response OOD arms, and the original-only P7 greedy prefix, but no prospective OOD composition of that fixed P7 with the exact residual-identity stream. This test reuses those physical interventions rather than opening another atlas.
anti_rank_drift: No DAS, learned subspace, rank, reconstruction, variance, or compression objective is present. This tests OOD prediction, cross-boundary grouping, executable composition, and selective two-stream necessity.
